gap: Tea apparel is mostly slogans ('But First, Tea', 'Spill the Tea'), kawaii boba or a single teacup in line art or watercolor. None found shows a full watercolor tea-time still life (teapot, cup, honey, lemon and spices) under a 'Tea Season' title, and no 'Tea Season' design turned up at all. Our angle: a cozy layered still life in the shop's 'X Season' format.
trend: Printify's winter guides put hoodies and sweatshirts at the top of winter sellers and name mugs for tea and coffee lovers; Printful's 2026 design-trends post lists food art and big, bold lettering. Tea-lover gift guides from Food Network, HGTV, Good Morning America, AOL and Uncommon Goods are live for this holiday season, and tea gifts carry on to Valentine's Day (Afternoon Tea Reads). No search-volume numbers were available, so demand is judged from these guides, not counted.
